items.source: jakarta.jms.JMSException - if thrown by JMS API methods
items.translation: jakarta.jms.JMSException - 如果由 JMS API 方法抛出

items.source: response - the outgoing JMS message about to be sent
items.translation: response - 即将发送的传出 JMS 消息

items.source: Alternatively, specify a JMS Destination object as "defaultResponseDestination".
items.translation: 或者，将 JMS 目标对象指定为"defaultResponseDestination"。

items.source: Return the MessagingMessageConverter for this listener, being able to convert Message.
items.translation: 返回此监听器的MessagingMessageConverter，使其能够转换Message。

items.source: Return the QosSettings to use when sending a response, or null if the defaults should be used.
items.translation: 返回用于发送响应的QosSettings，或者如果应使用默认值则返回null。

items.source: Resolve the default response destination into a JMS Destination, using this accessor's DestinationResolver in case of a destination name.
items.translation: 将默认响应目的地解析为 JMS `Destination`，如果是一个目的地名称，则使用此访问器的 DestinationResolver。

items.source: request - the original incoming JMS message
items.translation: request - 原始传入的 JMS 消息

items.source: The default implementation first checks the JMS Reply-To Destination of the supplied request; if that is not null it is returned; if it is null, then the configured default response destination is returned; if this too is null, then an InvalidDestinationException is thrown.
items.translation: 默认实现首先检查提供的请求的 JMS Reply-To `Destination`；如果该值不为 `null`，则返回它；如果为 `null`，则返回配置的默认响应目标；如果该值也为 `null`，则抛出InvalidDestinationException。

items.source: The default converter is a SimpleMessageConverter, which is able to handle BytesMessages, TextMessages and ObjectMessages.
items.translation: 默认转换器是SimpleMessageConverter，它能够处理BytesMessages、TextMessages和ObjectMessages。

items.source: Note: Does not support sending response messages based on result objects returned from listener methods. Use the SessionAwareMessageListener entry point (typically through a Spring message listener container) for handling result objects as well.
items.translation: 注意：不支持根据从监听器方法返回的结果对象发送响应消息。请使用SessionAwareMessageListener入口点（通常通过 Spring 消息监听器容器）来处理结果对象。

items.source: This method only applies when used as standard JMS MessageListener. In case of the Spring SessionAwareMessageListener mechanism, exceptions get handled by the caller instead.
items.translation: 此方法仅在作为标准 JMS `MessageListener` 使用时适用。在 Spring `SessionAwareMessageListener` 机制的情况下，异常由调用者处理。

items.source: Delegates the message to the target listener method, with appropriate conversion of the message argument. In case of an exception, the handleListenerException(Throwable) method will be invoked.
items.translation: 将消息委派给目标监听器方法，并对消息参数进行适当的转换。如果发生异常，将调用 handleListenerException(Throwable) 方法。

items.source:
Response destinations are only relevant for listener methods that return
result objects, which will be wrapped in a response message and sent to a
response destination.
items.translation: 响应目的地仅对返回结果对象的监听器方法有效，这些结果对象将被封装在响应消息中并发送至响应目的地。

items.source:
Alternatively, specify a "defaultResponseQueueName" or "defaultResponseTopicName",
to be dynamically resolved via the DestinationResolver.
items.translation: 或者，指定"defaultResponseQueueName"或"defaultResponseTopicName"，以便通过 DestinationResolver 动态解析。

items.source:
The default resolver is a SimpleDestinationResolver. Specify a
JndiDestinationResolver for resolving destination names as JNDI locations.
items.translation: 默认解析器为 SimpleDestinationResolver。请指定一个 JndiDestinationResolver 以将目标名称解析为 JNDI 位置。

items.source:
The default implementation sets the response's correlation id
to the request message's correlation id, if any; otherwise to the
request message id.
items.translation: 默认实现会将响应的相关标识符（correlation id）设置为请求消息的相关标识符（如有），否则设置为请求消息标识符。

items.source: Set the JmsHeaderMapper implementation to use to map the standard JMS headers. By default, a SimpleJmsHeaderMapper is used.
items.translation: 将 `JmsHeaderMapper` 实现设置为用于映射标准 JMS 标头。默认情况下，使用一个 `SimpleJmsHeaderMapper`。

items.source: Set the QosSettings to use when sending a response. Can be set to null to indicate that the broker's defaults should be used.
items.translation: 设置发送响应时使用的QosSettings。可设置为null以表示应使用代理的默认值。

items.source: Description copied from interface: SessionAwareMessageListener
items.translation: 描述从接口复制：SessionAwareMessageListener

items.source: Set the JmsHeaderMapper implementation to use to map the standard JMS headers.
items.translation: 将 `JmsHeaderMapper` 实现设置为用于映射标准 JMS 标头。

items.source: Set the QosSettings to use when sending a response.
items.translation: 设置发送响应时使用的QosSettings。

items.source: Pre-process the given result before it is converted to a Message.
items.translation: 在将给定结果转换为 `Message` 之前对其进行预处理。

items.source: Logger available to subclasses.
items.translation: 可供子类使用的 Logger。

items.source: Build a JMS message to be sent as response based on the given result object.
items.translation: 根据给定的结果对象构建要作为响应发送的 JMS 消息。

items.source: Extract the message body from the given JMS message.
items.translation: 从给定的 JMS 消息中提取消息正文。

items.source: Return the DestinationResolver for this adapter.
items.translation: 返回此适配器的 DestinationResolver。

items.source:
Return the converter that will convert incoming JMS messages to
listener method arguments, and objects returned from listener
methods back to JMS messages.
items.translation: 返回将传入的 JMS 消息转换为监听器方法参数的转换器，以及将监听器方法返回的对象转换回 JMS 消息的转换器。

items.source:
Handle the given result object returned from the listener method,
sending a response message back.
items.translation: 处理从监听器方法返回的结果对象，并发送响应消息。

items.source: Send the given response message to the given destination.
items.translation: 将给定的响应消息发送到给定的目的地。
